# `Tls12ServerFlow` — the TLS 1.2 server handshake

## Documentation

`TlsServerHandshake` (`specs/tls-handshake-server.md`) continues as the TLS 1.2 server (RFC 5246, RFC 8422) when
the ClientHello selects TLS 1.2: it hands the rest of the handshake to `Tls12ServerFlow`, which shares the machine's
`TlsSession`. A ClientHello selects TLS 1.2 when its supported_versions lists 0x0303 and TLS 1.3 is not selected, or
when it has no supported_versions and a legacy_version of 0x0303 or more, and the configuration enables TLS 1.2; TLS 1.3
is preferred when both sides allow it. It is `module` code in `stdlib/`, so a program outside `stdlib/` cannot name it
(E3088); the cases here are library-tier (`<!-- tier: stdlib -->`) and reach it, and the test seams, as a stdlib source
file does.

It follows the canra `tls12-handshake` contract. It negotiates in the contract's order and the server's own order of
preference: a null compression method, TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV refused while TLS 1.3 is enabled, an empty renegotiation_info
(signalled back for renegotiation_info or TLS_EMPTY_RENEGOTIATION_INFO_SCSV), extended_master_secret echoed exactly when
offered, the first enabled TLS 1.2 suite the client offered whose authentication fits the key (ECDHE-RSA for an RSA
key, ECDHE-ECDSA for an ECDSA or Ed25519 key), supported_groups and ec_point_formats, the first enabled group the client
supports, the first configured signature scheme the client offered and the key fits (RSA PKCS #1 v1.5 included), and
the first configured ALPN protocol the client listed. The server flight is one plaintext record: the ServerHello, whose
random carries the downgrade sentinel when TLS 1.3 is enabled, the Certificate, the ServerKeyExchange signed with the
scheme chosen over both randoms and the parameters, a CertificateRequest when client authentication is on, and
ServerHelloDone. A client Certificate is verified with `X509.verify` for the clientAuth purpose and no host name and
its CertificateVerify, over every handshake message through the ClientKeyExchange, with a scheme the request listed
and the key fits; `require` answers a client without a certificate with handshake_failure and `request` continues
without one. The client's change_cipher_spec and Finished must follow the flight, the Finished compared in constant
time, and the server answers with its own change_cipher_spec and Finished. A HelloRequest from a client is refused.

The vectors are the canra `tls12-handshake-server` contract: transcripts of the client of OpenSSL 3.0.13, the
reference client against the reference server, and the errors. A line prints the vector id and the canra expected
object, the Trace as compact JSON or the error name; the version is 771. Every one of the 31 canra vectors of this
spec has a case: the types leave none unspellable. Behaviour the vectors do not reach is pinned below them: 43 more
transcripts made with the canra reference client and checked by the canra reference server (the server's own
preferences, every ServerKeyExchange signature scheme, the signalling SCSVs, record shapes, client authentication, and
the messages a TLS 1.2 server refuses), the version a server negotiates for each configuration and ClientHello, and the
client and the server of this stdlib handshaking with each other in memory for every TLS 1.2 suite and server key type,
with and without extended master secret and client authentication, and for each combination of the versions the two
sides enable.

## Tests

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.replay-openssl-transcripts -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
Five transcripts the client of OpenSSL 3.0.13 sent to the canra reference server replay byte for byte: every record the server sends is the record the vector lists, the one-record server flight, change_cipher_spec, Finished, application data and close_notify included, and the master secret equals the one in OpenSSL's key log. They are ECDHE-ECDSA, ECDHE-RSA with AES-256-GCM over secp256r1, a handshake where the server required, and verified, OpenSSL's P-256 client certificate, ECDHE-RSA with a PKCS #1 v1.5 ServerKeyExchange signature, and a client without extended_master_secret.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsServerConfig, entropy TlsServerEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsServerReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

The canra reference client's TLS 1.2 handshakes with each server key type: a client limited to TLS 1.2 reaching a server that also enables TLS 1.3, which carries the downgrade sentinel in its random, a server limited to TLS 1.2 with a P-384 suite, with an RSA key (ChaCha20-Poly1305, and a PKCS #1 v1.5 ServerKeyExchange signature), with an ECDSA P-384 key and with an Ed25519 key, and a client without extended_master_secret, which gets the RFC 5246 master secret.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsServerConfig, entropy TlsServerEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsServerReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.client-authentication -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
A server that asks for a client certificate: it requires, and verifies with the clientAuth purpose and no host name, an ECDSA P-256 or an RSA PKCS #1 v1.5 client certificate, and with `request` it continues when the client sends an empty Certificate (the peer is not authenticated).
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsServerConfig, entropy TlsServerEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsServerReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.negotiation-errors -->

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.client-flight-errors -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
A client flight the server refuses: a ClientKeyExchange whose share is not a point is IllegalParameter, and a client Finished that does not verify is DecryptError.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsServerConfig, entropy TlsServerEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsServerReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.client-authentication-errors -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
A client the server refuses when it asks for a certificate: none under `require` (HandshakeFailure, where TLS 1.3 sends certificate_required), a chain from an unknown CA, a message other than the Certificate where it belongs, a CertificateVerify that does not verify and one whose scheme the request did not list or the key does not fit, and a request whose schemes no client certificate can answer.

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.reference-signatures-and-preferences -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
Handshakes made with the canra reference client and checked by the canra reference server, for the server's choices the canra vectors do not reach: the server's own suite, group and ALPN order, the first scheme of the server's list that the client offered and the key fits, RSA-PSS with SHA-384 and SHA-512 and RSA PKCS #1 v1.5 with SHA-256 and SHA-384 in the ServerKeyExchange, no ALPN when either side has none, TLS_EMPTY_RENEGOTIATION_INFO_SCSV answered with an empty renegotiation_info (the reference client then refuses the extension it did not send), and TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV, which is ignored when TLS 1.3 is disabled.

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.reference-record-shapes -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
More handshakes made with the canra reference client: a ClientHello split over two records, a client flight in 50-byte records, a warning alert before the change_cipher_spec and one after the handshake, which are ignored, application data written in fragments of 16384 bytes with an empty write between under AES-GCM and under ChaCha20-Poly1305, and records after close_notify, which are ignored unread.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsServerConfig, entropy TlsServerEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsServerReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

<!-- tier: stdlib -->
More client authentication made with the canra reference client: an Ed25519 client certificate under `require`, a P-256 one under `request`, an RSA one signing with RSA-PSS, and a request that lists certificate_authorities.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

function report(id String, config TlsServerConfig, entropy TlsServerEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsServerReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.reference-refusals -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
Records and messages the server refuses, made with the canra reference client: a change_cipher_spec whose body is not 1 or that comes before the ClientHello, a first message that is not a ClientHello, a ClientHello cut short, a ClientHello that offers no null compression, a TLS 1.3 only client, alerts before the ClientHello and during the handshake (a warning alert before the ClientHello is a refusal too, since no version is selected yet), application data before the change_cipher_spec, a Finished without it, a ClientKeyExchange that does not end its record or that takes the place of a requested Certificate, and a HelloRequest or a NewSessionTicket from the client after the handshake, a close_notify during the handshake, an empty handshake record, and a protected record whose version is not 0x0303 or whose body is too short to hold a nonce and a tag.

```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

function joined(items TextArray) returns String

		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

end 'joined'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.the-version-a-configuration-negotiates -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
A server answers the ClientHello it receives with the version its configuration allows. A ClientHello offering TLS 1.3 and TLS 1.2 gets a TLS 1.3 ServerHello and its compatibility change_cipher_spec unless TLS 1.3 is disabled, when it gets one TLS 1.2 flight in one record; a ClientHello offering only TLS 1.2 gets the TLS 1.2 flight, whose random carries the downgrade sentinel exactly when TLS 1.3 is enabled, and is refused with protocol_version when TLS 1.2 is disabled. A line prints the version, the records the server queued and whether the ServerHello random ends with the sentinel.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function peer() returns TlsX509Peer
	return TlsX509Peer.create(ByteArrays.create(), now: 0, purpose: X509Purpose.clientAuth)
end 'peer'

function configured(protocols TlsProtocolArray) returns TlsServerConfig
	var config = TlsServerConfig.defaults(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], key: TlsPrivateKey.ecP256(fromHex("0f9999d9198528f9f986f8315fe0c7aaf7b2aef840198d77b859dc4f4a8c4a2b")))
	config.protocols = protocols

	return config
end 'configured'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "none"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function hasDowngradeSentinel(firstRecord ByteArray) returns bool
	let body = tlsRecordPart(firstRecord, start: tlsRecordHeaderBytes, endIndex: firstRecord.count())
	let length = (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 1) as Count) * 65536 + (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 2) as Count) * 256 + (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 3) as Count)
	let decoded = try tlsDecodeHandshake(tlsRecordPart(body, start: 0, endIndex: 4 + length), protocol: TlsProtocol.tls13) otherwise panic("the first record of a server holds a ServerHello")

	return match decoded 'decoded'
		serverHello(hello) gives tlsRecordPart(hello.random(), start: tlsDowngradeSentinelOffset, endIndex: hello.random().count()).equals(tlsDowngradeSentinelTls12)
		default panic("the first message of a server is a ServerHello")
	end 'decoded'
end 'hasDowngradeSentinel'

function answer(label String, protocols TlsProtocolArray, hello ByteArray)
	let config = configured(protocols)
	let entropy = try TlsServerEntropy.fresh(config) otherwise panic("no entropy")
	var server = try TlsServerHandshake.create(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer()) otherwise panic("no server")

	try server.receive(hello) otherwise (failure) 'refused'
		print("{label} {failure} records={server.session().takeRecords().count()}\n")

		return
	end 'refused'

	let records = server.session().takeRecords()

	print("{label} version={renderVersion(server.session().negotiation)} records={records.count()} sentinel={hasDowngradeSentinel(try records.first() otherwise panic("a server answered"))}\n")
end 'answer'

function main() returns ExitCode
	let both = TlsProtocolArray from [TlsProtocol.tls13, TlsProtocol.tls12]
	let onlyTls12 = TlsProtocolArray from [TlsProtocol.tls12]
	let onlyTls13 = TlsProtocolArray from [TlsProtocol.tls13]
	let offeringBoth = fromHex("")
	let offeringTls12 = fromHex("")

	answer("both-enabled-client-offers-both", protocols: both, hello: offeringBoth)
	answer("tls13-disabled-client-offers-both", protocols: onlyTls12, hello: offeringBoth)
	answer("tls12-disabled-client-offers-both", protocols: onlyTls13, hello: offeringBoth)
	answer("both-enabled-client-offers-tls12", protocols: both, hello: offeringTls12)
	answer("tls13-disabled-client-offers-tls12", protocols: onlyTls12, hello: offeringTls12)
	answer("tls12-disabled-client-offers-tls12", protocols: onlyTls13, hello: offeringTls12)

	return 0
end 'main'
```

```stdout
both-enabled-client-offers-both version=772 records=3 sentinel=false
tls13-disabled-client-offers-both version=771 records=1 sentinel=false
tls12-disabled-client-offers-both version=772 records=3 sentinel=false
both-enabled-client-offers-tls12 version=771 records=1 sentinel=true
tls13-disabled-client-offers-tls12 version=771 records=1 sentinel=false
tls12-disabled-client-offers-tls12 protocolVersion records=1
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake-server.our-client-handshakes-with-our-server-over-tls12 -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
The client and the server of this stdlib handshake with each other in memory over TLS 1.2, each with the production entropy and the client verifying the server's chain for example.com: each of the six ECDHE suites (AES-128-GCM, AES-256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305, each with ECDSA and with RSA), each server key type (ECDSA P-256, ECDSA P-384, Ed25519, RSA) under the suite that fits it, a ServerKeyExchange signed with RSA PKCS #1 v1.5, a key exchange over secp256r1 instead of X25519, and a client without extended_master_secret, which both sides then derive the RFC 5246 master secret for. A line per side prints what it negotiated, whether it authenticated its peer, whether it saw the peer's close_notify and the application data it received; the server's line adds whether its ServerHello carried extended_master_secret.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

enum ServerKind
	p256
	p384
	ed25519
	rsa
end 'ServerKind'

enum ClientKind
	none
	p256
	ed25519
	rsa
end 'ClientKind'

enum Tweak
	none
	withoutExtendedMasterSecret
	serverSignsPkcs1
	clientSignsPkcs1
	secp256r1Only
end 'Tweak'

function serverCredential(kind ServerKind) returns (ByteArrays, TlsPrivateKey)
	return match kind 'kind'
		p256 gives (ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], TlsPrivateKey.ecP256(fromHex("0f9999d9198528f9f986f8315fe0c7aaf7b2aef840198d77b859dc4f4a8c4a2b")))
		p384 gives (ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], TlsPrivateKey.ecP384(fromHex("11afb2f77a2dec51c976f3225ec7e0eea79b70dab08e2ee263317047c621cd679b49f41aa42549e4cc3180e6191498a9")))
		ed25519 gives (ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], TlsPrivateKey.ed25519(fromHex("c875a7890a8054f285794a5414fbda9e4693700489f4bd2741908071978533a2")))
		rsa gives (ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], TlsPrivateKey.rsa(try RsaPrivateKey.parse(fromHex("")) otherwise panic("the case\'s RSA key was refused")))
	end 'kind'
end 'serverCredential'

function clientIdentity(kind ClientKind) returns TlsClientIdentity
	return match kind 'kind'
		none gives TlsClientIdentity.anonymous
		p256 gives TlsClientIdentity.certified(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], key: TlsPrivateKey.ecP256(fromHex("fd7e8e00621840dac0226ea921c19c18e46a79d944d6a3308b3f64cf009d82da")))
		ed25519 gives TlsClientIdentity.certified(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], key: TlsPrivateKey.ed25519(fromHex("8408cd68c509089a76695eb5c519ff0966fad7246013da6e9619f3032f71e404")))
		rsa gives TlsClientIdentity.certified(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], key: TlsPrivateKey.rsa(try RsaPrivateKey.parse(fromHex("")) otherwise panic("the case\'s RSA key was refused")))
	end 'kind'
end 'clientIdentity'

function onlyTls13() returns TlsProtocolArray
	return TlsProtocolArray from [TlsProtocol.tls13]
end 'onlyTls13'

function onlyTls12() returns TlsProtocolArray
	return TlsProtocolArray from [TlsProtocol.tls12]
end 'onlyTls12'

function bothVersions() returns TlsProtocolArray
	return TlsProtocolArray from [TlsProtocol.tls13, TlsProtocol.tls12]
end 'bothVersions'

function schemes(tweak Tweak, pkcs1Tweak Tweak, pkcs1 TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray, preference TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray) returns TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray
	if tweak == pkcs1Tweak 'pkcs1Only'
		return pkcs1
	end 'pkcs1Only'

	return preference
end 'schemes'

function groupsFor(tweak Tweak) returns TlsGroupCodeArray
	if tweak == Tweak.secp256r1Only 'single'
		return TlsGroupCodeArray from [0x0017]
	end 'single'

	return TlsGroupCodeArray from [0x001D, 0x0017]
end 'groupsFor'

function shareGroupsFor(tweak Tweak) returns TlsGroupCodeArray
	if tweak == Tweak.secp256r1Only 'single'
		return TlsGroupCodeArray from [0x0017]
	end 'single'

	return TlsGroupCodeArray from [0x001D]
end 'shareGroupsFor'

type OptionalExtendedMasterSecret implements TlsClientHelloSource
	var strips as bool

	static function create(strips bool) returns OptionalExtendedMasterSecret
		return Self{strips: strips}
	end 'create'

	function first(built ByteArray) returns ByteArray
		if not strips 'kept'
			return built
		end 'kept'

		let message = try tlsDecodeClientHello(built.clone()) otherwise panic("the ClientHello the config builds decodes")
		var kept = TlsExtensionArray.create()

		for item in tlsExtensionsOf(message.extensions()) 'eachExtension'
			if item.extensionType() != TlsExtensionKind.extendedMasterSecret.code() 'other'
				kept.push(item)
			end 'other'
		end 'eachExtension'

		let hello = TlsClientHello.create(message.legacyVersion(), random: message.random(), legacySessionId: message.legacySessionId(), cipherSuites: message.cipherSuites(), compressionMethods: message.compressionMethods(), extensions: TlsExtensionBlock.listed(kept))

		return try TlsHandshakeCodec.encode(TlsHandshakeMessage.clientHello(hello)) otherwise panic("a ClientHello without an extension encodes")
	end 'first'

	function second(built ByteArray) returns ByteArray
		return built
	end 'second'
end 'OptionalExtendedMasterSecret'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "none"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "none"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "none"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "none"
		negotiated(protocol) gives toHex(protocol)
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function serverHelloOffersExtendedMasterSecret(firstRecord ByteArray) returns bool
	let body = tlsRecordPart(firstRecord, start: tlsRecordHeaderBytes, endIndex: firstRecord.count())
	let length = (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 1) as Count) * 65536 + (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 2) as Count) * 256 + (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 3) as Count)
	let message = tlsRecordPart(body, start: 0, endIndex: 4 + length)
	let decoded = try tlsDecodeHandshake(message, protocol: TlsProtocol.tls13) otherwise panic("the first record of a server holds a ServerHello")

	return match decoded 'decoded'
		serverHello(hello) gives TlsExtensionScan.ofBlock(hello.extensions()).types.contains(TlsExtensionKind.extendedMasterSecret.code())
		default panic("the first message of a server is a ServerHello")
	end 'decoded'
end 'serverHelloOffersExtendedMasterSecret'

function messagesOf(record ByteArray) returns ByteArrays
	var messages = ByteArrays.create()
	var offset = tlsRecordHeaderBytes as ElementIndex

	while offset < record.count() 'eachMessage'
		let length = (tlsRecordByte(record, offset: offset + 1) as Count) * 65536 + (tlsRecordByte(record, offset: offset + 2) as Count) * 256 + (tlsRecordByte(record, offset: offset + 3) as Count)

		messages.push(tlsRecordPart(record, start: offset, endIndex: offset + 4 + length))
		offset = offset + 4 + length
	end 'eachMessage'

	return messages
end 'messagesOf'

function signatureSchemeOf(raw ByteArray) returns String
	let message = try tlsDecodeHandshake(raw, protocol: TlsProtocol.tls12) otherwise panic("a plaintext TLS 1.2 flight holds whole messages")

	return match message 'message'
		serverKeyExchange(exchange) gives "{exchange.signatureScheme()}"
		certificateVerify(scheme, _) gives "{scheme}"
		default panic("only signed messages are asked for")
	end 'message'
end 'signatureSchemeOf'

function signatureSchemeIn(record ByteArray, kind TlsHandshakeType) returns String
	for raw in messagesOf(record) 'eachMessage'
		let found = try TlsHandshakeType.fromRawValue(tlsRecordByte(raw, offset: 0)) otherwise panic("a flight holds known message types")

		if found == kind 'wanted'
			return signatureSchemeOf(raw)
		end 'wanted'
	end 'eachMessage'

	return "-"
end 'signatureSchemeIn'

function renderSide(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	return "connected={trace.connected} version={renderVersion(trace.negotiation)} suite={renderSuite(trace.negotiation)} group={renderGroup(trace.negotiation)} alpn={renderAlpn(trace.alpn)} peer-authenticated={trace.peerAuthenticated} peer-closed={trace.peerClosed} records={trace.outbound.count()} received={toHex(trace.received)}"
end 'renderSide'

function renderSchemes(trace TlsLoopbackTrace) returns String
	match trace.server.negotiation 'negotiation'
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 then return " server-key-exchange-scheme={signatureSchemeIn(try trace.server.outbound.first() otherwise panic("a server sent its flight"), kind: TlsHandshakeType.serverKeyExchange)} client-verify-scheme={signatureSchemeIn(try trace.client.outbound.get(1) otherwise panic("a client sent its flight"), kind: TlsHandshakeType.certificateVerify)}"
		pending or
		accepted or
		keyed then return ""
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSchemes'

function scenario(label String, serverKind ServerKind, clientKind ClientKind, serverProtocols TlsProtocolArray, clientProtocols TlsProtocolArray, suites TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray, tweak Tweak)
	let (chain, key) = serverCredential(serverKind)
	let mutual = clientKind != ClientKind.none
	let serverConfig = TlsServerConfig.create(serverProtocols, cipherSuites: suites, groups: groupsFor(tweak), signatureAlgorithms: schemes(tweak, pkcs1Tweak: Tweak.serverSignsPkcs1, pkcs1: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0401], preference: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0503, 0x0807, 0x0804, 0x0805, 0x0806, 0x0401, 0x0501, 0x0601]), applicationProtocols: TlsProtocolNameArray from [fromHex("687474702f312e31")], chain: chain, key: key, clientAuthentication: TlsClientAuthentication.require if mutual else TlsClientAuthentication.none, clientSignatureAlgorithms: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0503, 0x0807, 0x0804, 0x0805, 0x0806, 0x0401, 0x0501, 0x0601], clientAuthorities: ByteArrays.create())
	let clientConfig = TlsClientConfig.create(X509VerifyHost.named("example.com"), protocols: clientProtocols, cipherSuites: suites, groups: groupsFor(tweak), keyShareGroups: shareGroupsFor(tweak), signatureAlgorithms: schemes(tweak, pkcs1Tweak: Tweak.clientSignsPkcs1, pkcs1: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0503, 0x0401], preference: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0804, 0x0807, 0x0503, 0x0805, 0x0806, 0x0401, 0x0501, 0x0601]), applicationProtocols: TlsProtocolNameArray from [fromHex("687474702f312e31")], identity: clientIdentity(clientKind))
	let serverEntropy = try TlsServerEntropy.fresh(serverConfig) otherwise panic("no server entropy")
	let clientEntropy = try TlsClientEntropy.fresh(clientConfig) otherwise panic("no client entropy")
	let serverPeer = TlsX509Peer.create(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], now: 1767225600, purpose: X509Purpose.clientAuth)
	let clientPeer = TlsX509Peer.create(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], now: 1767225600, purpose: X509Purpose.serverAuth)
	var server = try TlsServerHandshake.create(serverConfig, entropy: serverEntropy, peer: serverPeer) otherwise panic("no server")
	var client = try TlsClientHandshake.create(clientConfig, entropy: clientEntropy, peer: clientPeer, helloSource: OptionalExtendedMasterSecret.create(tweak == Tweak.withoutExtendedMasterSecret)) otherwise panic("no client")
	let request = fromHex("474554202f20485454502f312e310d0a0d0a")
	let response = fromHex("485454502f312e3120323030204f4b0d0a0d0a6f6b")

	if let trace = try TlsLoopback.run(client, server: server, clientWrites: ByteArrays from [request], serverWrites: ByteArrays from [response], closeNotify: true) 'looped'
		let extended = serverHelloOffersExtendedMasterSecret(try trace.server.outbound.first() otherwise panic("a server sent its flight"))

		print("{label} client {renderSide(trace.client)}\n")
		print("{label} server {renderSide(trace.server)} extended-master-secret={extended}{renderSchemes(trace)}\n")
	end 'looped' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{label} refused {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'scenario'

function suiteList(suite TlsCipherSuiteCode) returns TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray
	return TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [suite]
end 'suiteList'

function main() returns ExitCode
	scenario("ecdsa-p256-aes-128-gcm", serverKind: ServerKind.p256, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02B], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("ecdsa-p384-aes-256-gcm", serverKind: ServerKind.p384, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02C], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("ecdsa-ed25519-chacha20-poly1305", serverKind: ServerKind.ed25519, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xCCA9], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("rsa-aes-128-gcm", serverKind: ServerKind.rsa, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02F], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("rsa-aes-256-gcm", serverKind: ServerKind.rsa, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC030], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("rsa-chacha20-poly1305", serverKind: ServerKind.rsa, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xCCA8], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("rsa-pkcs1-signature", serverKind: ServerKind.rsa, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02F], tweak: Tweak.serverSignsPkcs1)
	scenario("secp256r1-key-exchange", serverKind: ServerKind.p256, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02B], tweak: Tweak.secp256r1Only)
	scenario("without-extended-master-secret-ecdsa", serverKind: ServerKind.p256, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02B], tweak: Tweak.withoutExtendedMasterSecret)
	scenario("without-extended-master-secret-rsa", serverKind: ServerKind.rsa, clientKind: ClientKind.none, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xCCA8], tweak: Tweak.withoutExtendedMasterSecret)

	return 0
end 'main'
```

<!-- tier: stdlib -->
The client and the server of this stdlib handshake with each other in memory over TLS 1.2 with the server requiring a client certificate and verifying it for the clientAuth purpose: an ECDSA P-256, an Ed25519 and an RSA client certificate (the RSA one signing with RSA-PSS and, by configuration, with RSA PKCS #1 v1.5), under ECDHE-ECDSA and ECDHE-RSA suites, and without extended_master_secret.

```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "none"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "none"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "none"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "none"
		negotiated(protocol) gives toHex(protocol)
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function serverHelloOffersExtendedMasterSecret(firstRecord ByteArray) returns bool
	let body = tlsRecordPart(firstRecord, start: tlsRecordHeaderBytes, endIndex: firstRecord.count())
	let length = (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 1) as Count) * 65536 + (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 2) as Count) * 256 + (tlsRecordByte(body, offset: 3) as Count)
	let message = tlsRecordPart(body, start: 0, endIndex: 4 + length)
	let decoded = try tlsDecodeHandshake(message, protocol: TlsProtocol.tls13) otherwise panic("the first record of a server holds a ServerHello")

	return match decoded 'decoded'
		serverHello(hello) gives TlsExtensionScan.ofBlock(hello.extensions()).types.contains(TlsExtensionKind.extendedMasterSecret.code())

	end 'decoded'

function messagesOf(record ByteArray) returns ByteArrays
	var messages = ByteArrays.create()
	var offset = tlsRecordHeaderBytes as ElementIndex

	while offset < record.count() 'eachMessage'
		let length = (tlsRecordByte(record, offset: offset + 1) as Count) * 65536 + (tlsRecordByte(record, offset: offset + 2) as Count) * 256 + (tlsRecordByte(record, offset: offset + 3) as Count)

		messages.push(tlsRecordPart(record, start: offset, endIndex: offset + 4 + length))
		offset = offset + 4 + length
	end 'eachMessage'

	return messages
end 'messagesOf'

function signatureSchemeOf(raw ByteArray) returns String
	let message = try tlsDecodeHandshake(raw, protocol: TlsProtocol.tls12) otherwise panic("a plaintext TLS 1.2 flight holds whole messages")

	return match message 'message'
		serverKeyExchange(exchange) gives "{exchange.signatureScheme()}"
		certificateVerify(scheme, _) gives "{scheme}"
		default panic("only signed messages are asked for")
	end 'message'
end 'signatureSchemeOf'

function signatureSchemeIn(record ByteArray, kind TlsHandshakeType) returns String
	for raw in messagesOf(record) 'eachMessage'
		let found = try TlsHandshakeType.fromRawValue(tlsRecordByte(raw, offset: 0)) otherwise panic("a flight holds known message types")

		if found == kind 'wanted'
			return signatureSchemeOf(raw)
		end 'wanted'
	end 'eachMessage'

	return "-"
end 'signatureSchemeIn'

function renderSide(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	return "connected={trace.connected} version={renderVersion(trace.negotiation)} suite={renderSuite(trace.negotiation)} group={renderGroup(trace.negotiation)} alpn={renderAlpn(trace.alpn)} peer-authenticated={trace.peerAuthenticated} peer-closed={trace.peerClosed} records={trace.outbound.count()} received={toHex(trace.received)}"
end 'renderSide'

function renderSchemes(trace TlsLoopbackTrace) returns String
	match trace.server.negotiation 'negotiation'
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 then return " server-key-exchange-scheme={signatureSchemeIn(try trace.server.outbound.first() otherwise panic("a server sent its flight"), kind: TlsHandshakeType.serverKeyExchange)} client-verify-scheme={signatureSchemeIn(try trace.client.outbound.get(1) otherwise panic("a client sent its flight"), kind: TlsHandshakeType.certificateVerify)}"
		pending or
		accepted or
		keyed then return ""
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSchemes'

function scenario(label String, serverKind ServerKind, clientKind ClientKind, serverProtocols TlsProtocolArray, clientProtocols TlsProtocolArray, suites TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray, tweak Tweak)
	let (chain, key) = serverCredential(serverKind)
	let mutual = clientKind != ClientKind.none
	let serverConfig = TlsServerConfig.create(serverProtocols, cipherSuites: suites, groups: groupsFor(tweak), signatureAlgorithms: schemes(tweak, pkcs1Tweak: Tweak.serverSignsPkcs1, pkcs1: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0401], preference: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0503, 0x0807, 0x0804, 0x0805, 0x0806, 0x0401, 0x0501, 0x0601]), applicationProtocols: TlsProtocolNameArray from [fromHex("687474702f312e31")], chain: chain, key: key, clientAuthentication: TlsClientAuthentication.require if mutual else TlsClientAuthentication.none, clientSignatureAlgorithms: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0503, 0x0807, 0x0804, 0x0805, 0x0806, 0x0401, 0x0501, 0x0601], clientAuthorities: ByteArrays.create())
	let clientConfig = TlsClientConfig.create(X509VerifyHost.named("example.com"), protocols: clientProtocols, cipherSuites: suites, groups: groupsFor(tweak), keyShareGroups: shareGroupsFor(tweak), signatureAlgorithms: schemes(tweak, pkcs1Tweak: Tweak.clientSignsPkcs1, pkcs1: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0503, 0x0401], preference: TlsSignatureSchemeCodeArray from [0x0403, 0x0804, 0x0807, 0x0503, 0x0805, 0x0806, 0x0401, 0x0501, 0x0601]), applicationProtocols: TlsProtocolNameArray from [fromHex("687474702f312e31")], identity: clientIdentity(clientKind))
	let serverEntropy = try TlsServerEntropy.fresh(serverConfig) otherwise panic("no server entropy")
	let clientEntropy = try TlsClientEntropy.fresh(clientConfig) otherwise panic("no client entropy")
	let serverPeer = TlsX509Peer.create(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], now: 1767225600, purpose: X509Purpose.clientAuth)
	let clientPeer = TlsX509Peer.create(ByteArrays from [fromHex("")], now: 1767225600, purpose: X509Purpose.serverAuth)
	var server = try TlsServerHandshake.create(serverConfig, entropy: serverEntropy, peer: serverPeer) otherwise panic("no server")
	var client = try TlsClientHandshake.create(clientConfig, entropy: clientEntropy, peer: clientPeer, helloSource: OptionalExtendedMasterSecret.create(tweak == Tweak.withoutExtendedMasterSecret)) otherwise panic("no client")
	let request = fromHex("474554202f20485454502f312e310d0a0d0a")
	let response = fromHex("485454502f312e3120323030204f4b0d0a0d0a6f6b")

	if let trace = try TlsLoopback.run(client, server: server, clientWrites: ByteArrays from [request], serverWrites: ByteArrays from [response], closeNotify: true) 'looped'
		let extended = serverHelloOffersExtendedMasterSecret(try trace.server.outbound.first() otherwise panic("a server sent its flight"))

		print("{label} client {renderSide(trace.client)}\n")
		print("{label} server {renderSide(trace.server)} extended-master-secret={extended}{renderSchemes(trace)}\n")
	end 'looped' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{label} refused {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'scenario'

function suiteList(suite TlsCipherSuiteCode) returns TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray
	return TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [suite]
end 'suiteList'

function main() returns ExitCode
	scenario("mutual-ecdsa-client", serverKind: ServerKind.p256, clientKind: ClientKind.p256, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02B], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("mutual-ed25519-client-rsa-server", serverKind: ServerKind.rsa, clientKind: ClientKind.ed25519, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02F], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("mutual-rsa-client-pss", serverKind: ServerKind.p256, clientKind: ClientKind.rsa, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02B], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("mutual-rsa-client-pkcs1", serverKind: ServerKind.p384, clientKind: ClientKind.rsa, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xC02C], tweak: Tweak.clientSignsPkcs1)
	scenario("mutual-p256-client-rsa-server", serverKind: ServerKind.rsa, clientKind: ClientKind.p256, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xCCA8], tweak: Tweak.none)
	scenario("mutual-without-extended-master-secret", serverKind: ServerKind.p256, clientKind: ClientKind.p256, serverProtocols: onlyTls12(), clientProtocols: onlyTls12(), suites: TlsCipherSuiteCodeArray from [0xCCA9], tweak: Tweak.withoutExtendedMasterSecret)

	return 0
end 'main'
```

```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'
```
